title: Core Skills + Diagnostics
focus: See where you stand, build contest habits, and get the algebra fundamentals solid: systems, quadratics, factoring and inequalities.

title: AMC Thinking + Speed
focus: Sequences, number theory and modular arithmetic, counting with casework and complements, and probability, with timed sprints to build speed.

title: Strategy + Score Optimization
focus: Geometry (similar triangles, angle chasing, power of a point, coordinates), then timed tests, the 2-minute rule, refreshes and your danger zones.

title: Final Prep + Confidence
focus: Light review, fact sheets, identities, shortcuts and patterns: stay sharp and calm for contest day.
